scope: Complete bibliography of AI for Games in the Foundation Model Era v1, plus directly relevant existing GameMap research references and the seed survey. This is a bibliographic index, not a claim of exhaustive topic coverage or experiment reproduction.
metadataPolicy: For merged records, independently verified primary title and authors supplement the survey. The survey publication type, venue and publication year take precedence over an earlier arXiv submission year. Unmatched arXiv records use explicit verified venue comments when available; otherwise the catalog describes the indexed arXiv version without claiming that no later publication exists.
classificationPolicy: Roles and human-readable topics are editorial navigation aids derived from cited survey sections/system-index roles and existing research context.
verificationScope: All 419 bibliography entries were extracted and type-reviewed against the survey; 94 existing records and the seed survey have individually checked primary bibliographic metadata. Not every external destination among the 419 references was opened, read or reproduced.

limitations: The official conference PDF timed out in this check; the coauthor institution record provides all four authors, title, year, venue and DOI.
This is an archived two-page conference paper about procedural production and AI-assisted placement, not a modern foundation-model game-generation system.
The author-version PDF verifies all bibliographic fields. It explicitly restricts redistribution; this inventory links the original and does not redistribute the PDF.
This is a development-history dataset, not a claim of 950 runnable agent tasks. The author-hosted paper supplies title, two authors, year and DOI.

The official project BibTeX and author list verify title, nine authors and 2026. The 25.99 MB PDF exceeded the web fetch size limit; no full-paper reading or experiment reproduction is claimed. No arXiv ID or DOI was assigned from a guess.

exclusions.policy: Incidental source ledgers, service terms, production slides, specifications and duplicate supplementary files are outside the additional academic-paper inventory. The seed survey’s full bibliography remains included, with its nonacademic entries typed separately.

urlDerivationPolicy: For records with an explicitly identified arXiv paper but no supplied PDF URL, pdfUrl is derived using the standard official https://arxiv.org/pdf/{id} endpoint. A version explicitly cited in the canonical arXiv URL or source bibliography is retained. These 232 derived URLs were not individually fetched; this derivation does not upgrade any record’s primary-metadata verification status.

artifactReview.policy: Author publications, author-linked projects, repository contents and license texts establish the association and release scope. Survey-author resource mappings are candidate sources, not license proof. Public source without an established open-source software license is separate from open source. Placeholder and bibliography/material-only repositories do not count as published implementation code. Online entries exclude known paused/error Spaces, videos, leaderboards and dataset browsers. Local-run entries require actual application/inference/play instructions; code was not executed. No-result and inaccessible-source states do not establish that a work is closed source.
